apple-tv-user-sign-in.answer: Select each Apple TV user, authorize the desired Plozz profile, then enable Settings > Profiles > Automatically Sign In. The shared roster and server sign-ins do not make active selection or the trusted startup session shared: those remain system-user-local and opt-in. Manual switches and changed trust still require authorization; this is not a name match or server-user creation.

combined-library-browsing.answer: Apple TV All Libraries pages enabled non-music libraries across accounts in one grid, with identity-based merging where possible and original-server ownership preserved. Enable its navigation shortcut when multiple browsable libraries exist; horizontal tabs do not enable it by default. Choose a copy through the title's server/version selector. The current mobile app has no matching All Libraries destination.

continue-watching-retention.answer: Continue Watching, including merged Next Up titles, defaults to an unbounded provider feed with no age cutoff. Separate Next Up rows are previews of up to 20 titles, not the complete feed. Account-wide Continue Watching and server Next Up are queried independently of disabled library/catalogue discovery switches. Provider results, watched/dismissal state, account inclusion and server-user authorization still apply; hiding a library is not access control. Merge Next Up rows defaults on in Customize Home > Continue Watching, folding source-supplied next episodes into Continue Watching and hiding separate editor rows. Disable it to arrange those separately; removing Continue Watching suspends merging.

alphabet-navigation.answer: In an Apple TV name-sorted title browse, scroll a few rows down to reveal the indexed letter rail and focus a letter to jump. Collection members and other sorts do not qualify. Combined or Silo jumps load on demand; select the letter again after a failed jump, or change sort away and back to name to rebuild a failed index. Mobile has feedback/destination hooks but no constructed alphabet menu or rail entry point.

top-shelf.answer: Put Plozz in Apple TV's top Home Screen row. From an adult profile, Settings > Everyone > Top Shelf offers default-on Show Top Shelf, Posters (default) or Full Screen and independent 1-20 Continue Watching/Recently Added counts, defaulting to four each. Full Screen expands with tvOS swipe-up; Play requests playback while More Info opens details without autoplay. Poster selection requests playback. Preferences stay device-local across Plozz profiles; disabling clears media but retains choices. A saved, access-scoped Home snapshot is not live browsing; short feeds are not padded, same-source repeats deduplicate in Full Screen, and authorization/source failures remain visible. Artwork and full-screen spoilers respect profile policy.

community-skip-markers.answer: Settings > Playback > Skip intros, credits & more has Enable skipping, button/automatic behavior, movie/TV/anime eligibility, a 0-30-second automatic delay and optional per-marker rules including Off. These actions need markers. With skipping enabled, Use community markers (default on) checks IntroDB/TheIntroDB when server intro or credits markers are missing, filling missing marker kinds without replacing server markers. Requests send movie/series IMDb, TMDB or TVDB IDs plus applicable episode coordinates, ordering, episode name and runtime, not video files. Matching and database availability limit coverage. Turning this off stops community requests, not server-provided markers.

dual-subtitles.answer: Select primary text, then another text track through Apple TV Style > Dual Subtitles (or its direct control) or mobile Subtitles > Advanced… > Second Track; Off there removes only the second line. Mobile portrait starts in the ellipsis Playback options menu, while landscape separates controls. Plozzigen can decode embedded second text tracks; native playback needs fetchable text delivery. Image primaries disable dual mode and images cannot be second tracks. Locally remuxed wireless AirPlay has no selectable subtitles.

library-channels.answer: Open Live TV Sources > Plozz channels; enable the automatic lineup or Create custom channel. Automatic channels are not individually editable; Retry Plozz channels recovers preparation errors and Refresh Plozz channels rebuilds prepared lineups. For custom channels choose accessible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby libraries, movies/episodes, order and rules, then Preview schedule and Save channel. Missing/invalid durations exclude titles; blank rules allow all matches. Changes start after published programs. Cross-device schedules need catalogue snapshots. Update watch history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off; enabling it can mark 90%-viewed programs watched without resume writes. Playback uses original files, not IPTV or Silo sources.

offline-background.answer: On iPhone/iPad, select a movie/episode's server and version if offered before downloading; for a show use Manage Seasons to download available episodes or choose a season/episode. Choose quality, wait for completed status in Downloads and test that copy's video, audio and subtitles offline. Eligible HTTP transfers use background sessions; in-process/share transfers need foreground execution unless the OS grants continued processing. Switching profiles pauses that profile's transfers; return to the owning profile to resume. iOS/iPadOS 26 Live Activities can be declined; cancellation/expiry pauses active work without deleting partial files. All received bytes still require offline validation. Network, speed, source and storage limits remain; Apple TV has no downloads.

cross-server-history.answer: Sync across all my servers in Trackers (mobile also exposes Sync watch state across servers in Playback) defaults on and propagates watched-state/resume updates to matching accessible copies. Apple TV enables its control when multiple servers exist. Turning it off keeps writes scoped to the originating server. This is distinct from CloudKit configuration/profile sync and from scrobbling to third-party trackers; server identities and permissions still govern delivery.

version-selection.answer: Use the first-use Ask every time or Choose automatically choice and the title/player version controls where supported. Series-version memory is independent of prompt mode. Automatic mode can use a device recommendation when the remembered type is missing; it does not promise that every episode has the same file.

device-setup.answer: Choose Set up from another device on the receiver and send from the configured device's iCloud Sync screen over the same local network, allowing Local Network access. Use nearby selection, code or QR; camera permission is needed for scanning. Compare codes when prompted; same-account rendezvous can authenticate without that comparison. Only supported credentials transfer. Mobile iCloud Keychain can separately adopt supported server/share/Seerr logins; Apple TV uses pairing or sign-in instead and Silo always needs its own device approval.

App/PlozziOS/Info.plist.summary: Local Network permission supports discovery/pairing; Camera is used for setup QR scanning with code entry as an alternative. Background audio, processing and download task identifiers support documented route- and OS-dependent behavior, not guaranteed execution. External-app query schemes support Infuse/VLC availability; the registered return URL is routed by the mobile root through validated external playback receipts into authorized viewer-owned watch mutations, not accepted as arbitrary progress.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.branded.entitlemen.omitReason: Side-by-side development builds intentionally omit canonical cloud and associated-domain capabilities; these internal provisioning variants are not consumer setup features.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.entitlements.summary: CloudKit/presence and pairing universal links are wired; supported mobile credentials use a separate synchronizable Keychain path rather than making all CloudKit server descriptors authenticated.

App/Resources/Info.plist.summary: The declared Guide-button activity is consumed by MainTabView only when Live TV is enabled, then opens the full-screen channel player's guide. Background audio uses the music controller and Now Playing session for screensaver listening and Control Center commands. External-app query schemes detect Native Player/Infuse/VLC; RootView routes the registered callback into nonce-, URL-, age- and authorization-validated receipts before AppState writes viewer-owned progress. External handoff is separate from AirPlay and Apple's in-app native engine.

App/Resources/Plozz.branded.entitlements.omitReason: Empty entitlements belong to internal side-by-side development builds; production Apple TV user management and Top Shelf use the canonical entitlements instead.

TopShelf/ContentProvider.swift.summary: The extension renders the shared saved snapshot as native poster sections or a details carousel. Full Screen has distinct Play/More Info routes; both resolve only within admitted active accounts. The adult settings entry controls default-on visibility, style and per-feed counts on this device without broadening source permissions.

TopShelf/TopShelf.branded.entitlements.omitReason: This development-only Top Shelf extension deliberately lacks the canonical app group; it does not add a user-facing control or alternative setup procedure.

connections.summary: Connect supported media servers, approved Silo devices, IPTV accounts, or wired share transports; distinguish shared sign-ins from profile library selection. Compare Silo approval codes. Restore saved Jellyfin/Plex/Emby/Silo credentials through Settings > Servers > Sign In Again, opening the account row first on mobile. The same account/server/profile is required; cancellation or failed verification leaves the connection intact. Retry reachability before reauthenticating an offline server. Manage verified local/remote addresses per sign-in and device, with trust, HTTP and Silo approval limits, then confirm actual access. Tailscale needs a connection on the playback device and manual server IP/MagicDNS entry, not LAN discovery.

library.summary: Browse, filter, sort, search and combine enabled video libraries on Apple TV; distinguish the wired name-sort letter rail and reachable failure recovery from unused shared alphabet-menu code and mobile feedback hooks. Find collections, extras and IPTV on-demand libraries, choose a server/version copy, manage profile Watchlists including WeTrakr planning-list changes, and update watched state. Remove from Continue Watching uses provider dismissal while retaining position when possible, otherwise clears resume without marking watched; cross-server history policy controls matching copies. Explain incomplete collections and recovery. Distinguish request results from playable copies, presentation from access, and upcoming dates/unaired placeholders from playable ownership or automatic acquisition. Customize Libraries has shared profile tab order/visibility and per-account/library Recommended rows, separately from main navigation and Home. New visits use the first supported visible mode; Browse is the fallback when needed. Explain reset scope, unsupported share recommendations, discovery retry and No visible rows recovery.

home-navigation.summary: Customize Home offers presets with replacement confirmation, Add/Remove section and Reorder/Done; edits stop following server order without editing the server. Home layout/Hero stays pinned. Add section > Create section chooses an accessible collection, Posters/Landscape/Featured, a sampled preview and optional Section name, then Add to Home. Content/Save changes edits it later; the selection remains server-user-qualified. Empty and unavailable Home sections are distinct from connection failure and saved choices survive. Account-wide history ignores disabled library discovery. Continue Watching and merged Next Up have no age/count cap, whereas separate Next Up rows show up to 20 titles; merging defaults on and is independently controlled. Keep Showcase versus Fullscreen Hero, Discovery providers, Seerr request/Kids boundaries, independent card actions, navigation Show overrides and mobile More. Library layouts and independent logo/text sizing have linked task sections. Detail-page theme music, now wired in both shells, has its volume/preview workflow in audio and remains independent of Home trailers.

appearance.summary: Group themes, card density, labels, focus emphasis and watched indicators. Label presets replace per-view overrides; Home/Recommended Mixed hides captions in Showcase or on series artwork. Continue Watching separately follows Appearance or forces labels On/Off. Contextual Card labels in Home, Libraries and Detail Page edit the same preferences, not another override layer; collection/playlist members use Browse. Retain Liquid Glass, artwork-source scopes, saved download images and interface/media/server-language/device-region distinctions. Logo size and Text size are independent for Home Hero, Apple TV Showcase, Detail Page and TV library Recommended headers. Text scales title fallbacks, descriptions and metadata, plus TV detail episode titles/synopses, not cards/menus. The center marks default; constrained headers can fit down without rewriting the saved preference.

spoilers.summary: Spoiler Protection now belongs to Settings > Screens & Navigation under All screens on TV/mobile, not Appearance. Retain platform-specific toggle labels, blur/placeholder, in-progress image/text treatment and independent hidden review scores/reveal. Chapters follow the same spoiler rules. Continue Watching Artwork + logo/Thumbnail/Poster, Playback details and Labels are independent; only Thumbnail uses episode stills. Restore a removed section with Add section. Center button action/mobile When tapping an item defaults to Play or opens details; TV Play/Pause remains direct playback. None of these presentation controls changes watched state or row membership.

circadian.summary: Set solar-region, manual or always-on dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview a day, disable the effect, and separate profile-owned app tint from system or TV settings.

playback.summary: Use controls and same-account versions, first-use Ask every time/Choose automatically and independent series memory; automatic mode can fall back to recommendations while ask mode also applies to autoplay. Mobile portrait consolidates menus in the ellipsis Playback options control; landscape separates them. Retain autoplay/community-marker defaults, Up Next, content/marker-specific skipping, automatic delay, resume rewind and speed. Session-only Zoom Mode offers Normal, Crop, Stretch and 50%-200% Custom with different framing/proportion consequences. Chapters seeks usable server or playback-path-dependent file chapters, including shares/local downloads; mobile tabs scroll horizontally. Missing images do not remove chapters; skip markers are separate. Cast page navigation ends playback and credits need not be playable. The external-player guide covers device-wide choice, platform apps, direct Plex/Jellyfin/Emby video only, source/conversion fallback, token-bearing links, SRT handoff, custom templates and authorized 24-hour progress returns; Native Player/Infuse support resume/returns, VLC/custom do not.

quality.summary: Set profile-owned mobile defaults or apply Video > Quality for one session, starting in Playback options in portrait. Maximum means original quality; forced conversion is separate. Current stream reports active rendition facts, never substituted limit values; Not available is not codec/resolution evidence. Declared stream bitrate is advertised, not measured network speed. Retain provider/platform and Silo limits and fitting-original behavior. Device-local Video buffer is temporary read-ahead sampled for new sessions, not quality or offline downloads; space/path limits and sustained slow throughput still apply. Separate local Live TV buffer requests a new-load cushion with delay/tuning tradeoffs, respected by Go Live without adding recording capability. External handoff stays in Plozz when mobile policy is below Maximum or forces conversion, even when an original fits.

audio.summary: Select tracks/language; series memory stores language, not an exact commentary track, codec or mix, and can follow matched series across servers. Retain no adjustable engine audio delay, opt-in mobile Background Audio/data use, and output-gated TV Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue with system-wide scope and Settings recovery. Detail Page > Background > Theme music now plays through the shared controller on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. Theme music volume is 0%-100%; adjusting it can preview automatically and Play preview/Stop preview provide explicit control. Preview resolution checks authorized Home titles, then can use a generated sample if none supplies a theme; a preview is not universal title availability. Leaving the page stops the preview. Detail music fades in, pauses outside the app, and yields to trailers/full playback. Off selects static detail art independently of Home trailers and video tracks.

subtitles.summary: Select/search tracks, distinguish forced/SDH and per-content policies, enter mobile language codes or follow device language, style text or Live TV, and manage second tracks. Mobile Subtitles > Advanced… contains Second Track, Subtitle Delay and Appearance > Style; Search & Download… opens search separately. Portrait starts in Playback options. Prefer SDH permits fallback; Only SDH makes automatic/search/download choices strict without overriding manual or remembered choices. Matching device caption style replaces custom appearance after confirmation; edits exit matching while placement/dual controls remain Plozz-specific. Explain embedded Plozzigen versus fetchable native text, image-primary exclusion, secondary Off, timing and AirPlay limits. External apps receive eligible fetchable SRT sidecars without Plozz styling/dual guarantees; custom templates receive no subtitle links.

music.summary: Find Apple TV music from supported server libraries, start album/playlist sessions, use shuffle/repeat and mini-player controls, continue listening through the screensaver and use Control Center Now Playing transport controls. Trace the background-audio declaration through the controller and shared system-command session. Explain synchronized lyrics availability and Last.fm eligibility without promising mobile music or downloads. AudioPlaybackController admits only nonempty synchronized lyrics, despite plain-text support in the model/view, so omit plain-lyrics instructions as unwired.

live-tv.summary: Set up IPTV or server channels and distinguish direct M3U catalogues from web pages, single-stream HLS and XMLTV. The main sign-in form exposes EPG URL (optional); Advanced options adds guides, playlist authentication and separate playlist/stream versus guide headers. Guide headers are scoped to the first guide URL's server, with empty fields following playlist credentials. Prefer HTTPS. Explain device-local account file imports separately from encrypted source-copy sync. Find on-demand libraries, correct guide mappings, favorite/hide channels and run per-playlist reachability checks. Review channel identities restores a saved channel only after same-station/feed confirmation; favorites, hidden state and guide corrections follow that identity, otherwise the separate entry remains playable. Channels/Programs search tunes live, not from programme start. Kids playlist-source PIN approvals grant the whole source locally, not ratings-based filtering or server-account authorization. Retain four-pane/provider Multiview limits, previews and original-file library-channel schedule/history limits; history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off. Mobile Settings > Live TV > Stop without Wi-Fi or Ethernet gates detected network changes, not every request; brief cellular use remains possible. Low Data Mode independently pauses Live TV even on Wi-Fi; use an unrestricted connection. Automatic-lineup Retry/Refresh is distinct from custom-channel editing. Live TV buffer is a local new-load cushion with latency/tuning costs, respected by Go Live, not a recording or a buffer for scheduled library files.

offline.summary: Select the intended source/version on mobile details before downloading and test the validated, completed copy offline. Manage Seasons downloads available episodes, not placeholders. Preparing/Downloading/Finishing are not completion; all bytes still need offline validation. Distinguish background HTTP from in-process/share work and fallible iOS 26 continued processing. Switching profiles pauses outgoing transfers; return to the owning profile to resume, subject to network policy. Retain quality/network policy, provider preparation, track limits, speed caps and uncapped background behavior. Reduced Jellyfin/Emby copies require Download Speed > Limit > Unlimited. Storage in Download Settings shows download use and available device capacity. Cancel Active Downloads deletes unfinished copies but keeps completed ones; Delete All Downloads removes this profile's saved videos, not server originals. Pause preserves work; notifications need permission. Completion notices open the title or batch without autoplay and require authorization for the owning profile rather than bypassing its lock.

profiles.summary: Separate app profiles/server users/Apple TV system users, mobile editing/switching, profile locks/Plex PIN reuse and automatic startup trust. Library discovery switches do not remove account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up or impose server maturity restrictions. A household PIN enforces Kids settings/switching and Seerr admin-request gates. Playlist approvals are whole-source, local and tied to source/profile identity, not ratings filtering. No forgotten-PIN reset is wired; another device must already permit unlocked editing to remove a synced lock. Preserve shared household versus system-user-local distinctions.

sync.summary: Distinguish CloudKit configuration, encrypted tracker tokens, mobile Keychain adoption, provider-limited nearby transfer and Silo approval. Explain network/permission/code-verification requirements and separate cross-server history. Display Size, navigation style and main shortcut arrangement stay local per profile, as do Apple TV accidental-exit prevention and title zoom, rather than syncing or transferring; library-tab order does transfer. Downloads/startup/Video buffer/Live TV buffer/Top Shelf remain local too. Diagnostics consent is neither synced nor transferred and is not profile-owned. External-player selection is device-wide and local; returned progress stays with the authorized original viewer/server. Live TV source copies sync encrypted per profile; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local, schedules need snapshots, and legacy source import differs from account import. Refresh Breakdown shows encoded local payload/count snapshots, not iCloud storage: include pending uploads/catalogue schedules; exclude pending deletions/downloaded IPTV guides and separate Keychain/Trakt records. On all three platforms iCloud Sync > Troubleshooting offers Reload From iCloud and destructive Reset Sync; distinguish downloading shared settings from replacing them with this device's copy. Retain erase/re-upload prevention and mobile Keychain erasure. Transferable presentation preferences grant neither access nor unsupported modes.

tracking.summary: Connect profile-owned video/anime/music trackers and check media/account/build eligibility. Distinguish outbound playback-to-history scrobbling from readable/writable Watchlists: Plozz does not import a tracker's complete watch history into media servers. Supported external returns can deliver unfinished Trakt pause progress through the durable watch outbox; finished returns keep normal history reporting. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. WeTrakr is enabled by the production flag but still requires configured client credentials; its settings, both playback fan-outs and planning-list destination are wired. Document its authorization, Watchlist behavior, Retry/profile-wide Reconnect and failed-revocation recovery without promising the row in an unconfigured build.

requests.summary: Configure authorized Seerr and each profile's acting user; explain quotas, relinking and standard requests versus offline downloads or 4K requests. TMDB-matched library shows expose season request/status on Apple TV and Manage Seasons on mobile: request a season/All Missing, refresh status and handle failure/decline in Seerr. Requested · Unreleased indicates an approved request with a known future release and no reported download activity, not a promised download start; pending requests remain distinct. Kids/admin checks run in both shells/ProfileStore but unrestricted admin requests require a household Parental PIN to block them; also choose a restricted Seerr user. Release & Availability is independent of request status, playable ownership and paid-service entitlement.

metadata.summary: Explain shared metadata priorities/disablement, local TMDB credential verification, profile artwork choices and source/build-dependent review scores. Show content ratings is a default-on profile setting under Screens & Navigation > All screens; turning it off hides classifications on Home/details/Top Shelf, not review scores or Common Sense guidance, and never enforces access restrictions. Common Sense detail requires viewing-account Plex Pass. Shares support matching video-stem NFO, show-root tvshow.nfo and named local artwork after rescan/metadata work, subject to unambiguous supported associations and artwork policy. Cache clearing affects lookup data/derived images, not downloads or server matching. External-title Release & Availability shows device-region releases and TMDB/JustWatch offers, independently of Seerr, playable ownership and subscriptions; missing offers do not prove unavailability.

help.summary: Keep symptom checks and reset/cache scopes non-destructive. Incomplete results offer Details/Try Again; No streams found rechecks inventory, not playback. Restore saved sign-ins without deleting connections; Plex Home can require the original account, not a PIN reset. Cover Discord/GitHub/mobile email, duplicate checks and safe reproduction/device/source details. Startup diagnostics choices both continue; reporting defaults off and needs current consent plus a configured endpoint. Consent is not profile-owned or transferred. Automatic Sentry reports include fixed screen categories/performance evidence but exclude identity/server/media/history. Explicit logs include retained playback/source evidence and the optional message; Submitted confirms SDK handoff, not receipt or a public issue. Privacy Policy is reachable in consent/Settings, with a TV QR handoff. Apple TV Home Performance Overlay is wired through MainTabView/HomeView and exposes FPS, hitches and thermal state for stutter reports; the mobile toggle has no Home renderer consumer, so do not promise a mobile overlay. Local error details need no upload consent. Retain safe cache/reset scopes and distinguish diagnostics from downloads/recordings.

platforms.summary: Explain remote/touch/keyboard, VoiceOver, optional gestures, iPhone full-window orientation versus iPad system rotation, and TV fades that do not enable system matching. Mobile pinch switches Normal/Crop; the playback task explains session-only zoom modes. Apple TV Zoom when opening titles is a separate default-off, device-local profile choice that respects Reduce Motion. Top Shelf offers shared local adult controls, Posters/Full Screen and 1-20 counts defaulting four; source-scoped snapshots retain authorization/spoiler limits. Trace Guide OS entry and music Now Playing commands. Distinguish live seeking/Go Live from library-channel Jump to now and recording. Live TV buffer applies on new live stream loads, not library files, and Go Live retains its latency/tuning tradeoffs. Conversion diagnostics separate active video/audio facts from original-source details; neither establishes physical speaker layout. Throughput is not encoded bitrate and temporary cache is not downloads. Retain remuxed AirPlay subtitle loss, Multiview/PiP limits and authorized external-player returns.

FeatureAuth.summary: Keep provider sign-in and verified alternate addresses in the server task. Saved-account Sign In Again is wired in both shells for Jellyfin/Plex/Emby/Silo, validates the original account/server/profile and replaces credentials without deleting the saved connection; cancellation/failure preserves it. Network retry and IPTV/share connection editing remain separate. Plex Home recovery reauthenticates the original Plex account before the intended user's normal access/PIN checks, not a PIN reset.

FeatureDiscovery.summary: Use LAN discovery or manual entry; Tailscale is an externally configured connection requiring the server's IP/MagicDNS address, not a Plozz-managed VPN or discoverable LAN server.

FeatureHome.summary: Keep browsing, collections/recovery, source/version selection, Watchlists and schedule-only placeholders together. No streams found rechecks inventory without playback; incomplete results retain Details/Try Again. Document the wired tvOS letter rail, not unused LibraryAlphabetMenu/mobile observed state. Both shells honor supported library presentation and hidden-row recovery. Source-qualified custom Home collections survive failures; empty differs from unavailable. Account-wide history ignores disabled-library discovery. Regional offers do not grant playable ownership. Both TV and mobile item details now invoke shared theme-music playback with authorization and lifecycle gating; audio explains volume, preview and generated-sample limits. Apple TV Home's performance overlay supports the feedback stutter procedure, not a new performance-settings page.

FeatureLiveTV.summary: Cover reachable channel menus, previews, Multiviews, guide search/correction, source-scoped channel-identity review, local Kids playlist approvals and channel checks. The mobile destination wires the network policy into playback eligibility: Wi-Fi-only enforcement follows detected changes, while Low Data Mode independently pauses live playback until an unrestricted connection is available. Automatic library channels offer preparation Retry and ready-state Refresh, but no individual editing; custom channels retain their separate editor. Guide options reaches Review channel identities; confirmed historical identity is applied by the durable cache/import model and reuses saved preferences only when the old entry is absent. The playlist detail's SettingsPageLink reaches scanning; its global Sources destination is nested under library-channel management and unreliable. Source-copy import exists for legacy/fallback flows and syncs differently from current IPTV-account file imports; do not invent a universal alternate import procedure. Personal channel-label/preferences and the separate unavailable-favorite recovery helper have no prototype presentation route, so omit them as unusable controls without confusing them with the reachable identity review.

FeatureMusic.summary: Cover Apple TV server-library listening, queue controls, lyrics and Last.fm in the music guide, including screensaver/background listening and the wired Control Center Now Playing transport session.

FeaturePlayback.summary: Use task sections for player preferences, text/image/dual-subtitle limits, confirmed caption-style replacement and live rewind. Mobile menus consolidate in portrait and separate in landscape; Advanced… owns second subtitles, delay and style, while Video owns Quality/zoom. Session-only Normal/Crop/Stretch/Custom zoom has an explained 50%-200% range. Chapters needs usable provider/file chapters; seeking preserves play/pause intent and episode spoilers, and thumbnails are optional. Series audio memory stores language, not an exact mix. Live TV buffer is a new-load cushion with latency/tuning costs, separate from library files. Neither wired engine advertises audio-delay or engine-local dialogue processing; the TV system bridge separately exposes output-gated global Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue and recovery. Cast page navigation ends playback. Diagnostics separate active conversion facts, original sources, measured throughput, player-window/buffer values and temporary cache without claiming physical speaker layout. PlayerScreenshotHook and LiveChannelScreenshotHook only preselect panels for internal capture; they expose no reader screenshot workflow.

FeatureProfiles.summary: Cover profile setup, entry/edit authorization, Kids restrictions and device-local automatic sign-in. The Forgot PIN strings in ProfileLockCopy have no presentation call site; both the shared entry PIN screen and management actions lack a reset control. Do not promise recovery from unused labels; another device must already have unlocked editing access before removing a synced lock.

FeatureSettings.summary: Group by task and platform/provider applicability, not by toggle. Preserve collection-Home and library-layout procedures, shared Card labels, independent Logo/Text sizing, spoilers and classification controls without conflating ratings or restrictions. Detail background music now works in both shells; audio explains continuous volume and preview, including generated fallback rather than universal title music. TV navigation zoom remains separate from playback zoom. Skipping, independent buffers, saved-sign-in recovery and sync-data sizes stay in their tasks. Feedback explains diagnostics consent, explicit upload/submission status, reachable Privacy Policy and Apple TV Home stutter measurements. Reload/reset are reachable in both sync troubleshooting UIs. External-player choice retains its focused guide for device scope, eligibility, token sharing and returned progress. Low-risk sort/recently-watched controls need no new pages.

FeatureSyncCloud.summary: Separate settings/profile/media/tracker channels from mobile Keychain adoption. Profile preference capture excludes device-specific density, main navigation and exit/zoom settings; their per-profile stores do not make them transferable. Live TV source secrets/imported source chunks are encrypted; sync cannot grant local parental approval or materialize an account-imported M3U on another device. Explain on-demand local payload/count snapshots and their exclusions without representing them as CloudKit storage usage. Keep destructive reset/erase warnings and schedule catalogue requirements.

FeatureSyncSetup.summary: Explain reachable receiver/sender setup, local network and scan permissions, code/QR alternatives, conditional verification and provider transfer limits. Same-account rendezvous and scanned QR pin the recipient key; ordinary links do not silently bypass verification.

MediaDownloads.summary: Explain network/speed limits, provider copies and offline validation: Finishing/all bytes received is not completion. Background HTTP differs from in-process share work; continued processing/Live Activities remain an OS decision. Profile transitions quiesce outgoing transfers and returning can resume them under normal network policy. Storage shows download use and available capacity. Distinguish pause/resume from destructive bulk cancellation of unfinished copies and profile-scoped deletion of saved downloads.

MediaTransportCore.omitReason: Internal file-system capability and bounded-read contracts expose no independent reader setting or procedure. Protocol selection, authentication, scanning and download limits are documented under connections and offline viewing instead.

MediaTransportFTP.summary: Cover FTP and manually addressed implicit FTPS in the share task; composition does not produce explicit AUTH TLS connections.

MediaTransportHTTP.omitReason: Shared HTTP range validation, sessions and trust plumbing support WebDAV and media reads, not a separately selectable HTTP library type. Documenting this implementation as another source would misrepresent the add-share UI.

MediaTransportNFS.summary: State the wired NFSv3 requirement and export-based access rules in the network-share procedure, not a separate protocol guide.

MetadataKit.summary: Keep provider ordering/cache controls in metadata, lyric availability in music and community skips in playback. Home explains selecting public Discovery catalogues independently of Seerr requests, with Kids restrictions and no implied playable ownership. This is recommendation discovery, not the FeatureDiscovery module's LAN server search. Marker requests include applicable title/episode metadata and runtime, not video uploads; server markers and third-party coverage remain distinct. Regional releases/watch offers are populated only for external/discovery details and rendered independently of Seerr; explain them beside title requests without requiring a request connection.

ProviderIPTV.summary: Keep playlist/Xtream and EPG setup, scoped guide credentials, local account-file imports, guide-only operation and optional on-demand catalogues in existing source/library tasks. HTTP/proxy/parsing diagnostics do not add a new selectable source type.

ProviderShare.summary: Cover share connection/scanning and movie/TV local NFO/artwork association in existing guides. Personal Videos deliberately bypasses catalogue matching. Local metadata precedence and ambiguous-folder rejection are implemented in scanner/enrichment/projection, not inferred from NFO filenames alone.

TopShelfKit.summary: Document Apple TV placement, local shared visibility/layout/count preferences, same-copy deduplication, Play versus More Info and current access checks. Full-screen metadata uses known source facts, series artwork and spoiler policy, never a guarantee of output or a live server browser. Poster/backdrop composition is infrastructure, not another reader control.

TraktService.summary: Separate Watchlist sync, completed watches and partial pause progress returned by supported external players. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. Shared sign-in recovery belongs in trackers; receipt/debug response plumbing needs no separate user procedure.

WetrakrService.summary: Production-enabled but configuration-gated video tracking and planning-list read/write integration is reachable on both platforms. Cover authorization and connection recovery in trackers and list propagation in library. View on WeTrakr, when present for imported entries, is an external link/TV QR handoff rather than media playback; this self-explanatory link needs no standalone guide.

appearance.summary: Keep theme/cards/artwork together and Circadian scheduling in its focused task. Spoiler Protection moved to Screens & Navigation > All screens; do not retain an Appearance route.

language.summary: Use the appearance guide to explain System language selection and distinguish interface language from audio, subtitles, server-supplied metadata and device-region date/number formatting rather than a separate picker guide. System-drawn player controls and permission prompts keep the device language.

libraries.summary: Explain shared sign-ins versus profile-selected accounts/server users and library discovery switches. Disabled libraries hide browsing/discovery, not account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up, and are not permission or maturity filters. Keep music eligibility in its platform-specific task.

liveTV.summary: Keep guide previews, favorites/hidden channels, search and mobile cellular policy in the Live TV reference. Distinguish the Wi-Fi-only setting's detected-transition limit from the independent Low Data Mode pause, which also applies on Wi-Fi. Explain local whole-source Kids approval and source-configuration sync separately; straightforward ordering/filter choices need no individual pages.

playback.summary: Cover version mode/series memory, autoplay/skips, quality, audio, background listening, orientation/gestures and history with platform/provider gates. Skip settings distinguish enablement, content categories, button/automatic delay and per-marker Off; community requests remain separately controllable. Remember audio language per series stores language, not exact commentary/mix. Video buffer is temporary read-ahead, while independent local Live TV buffer requests a live-edge cushion; both are new-load choices, not offline downloads. Missing remembered versions fall back automatically in automatic mode. Advanced > External player is device-wide rather than profile-owned; its focused guide explains platform apps, custom templates, direct-play fallback, access-token sharing and authorized progress returns.

screensNavigation.summary: Home sections/presets, source-qualified collections, default-on Next Up merging and pinned TV Home layout/mobile Hero share the Home task. Retain Discovery/Seerr/Kids limits, independent Continue Watching presentation/actions and explicit navigation Show. Customize Libraries edits supported profile tabs and per-library Recommended rows, not Home or shortcuts. Logo/Text sizing and contextual labels belong with appearance. All screens owns spoilers/classification display, not scores or restrictions. Detail Background offers mutually exclusive Trailer/Theme music/Off on all three platforms, independently of Home trailers; audio explains continuous 0%-100% volume, automatic/explicit preview and generated-sample limits. TV title-opening zoom remains default-off, Reduce-Motion-aware and local, not playback zoom.

subtitles.summary: Combine language codes/device fallback, per-content policies, SDH/search, remembered series choices and text/image styling limits rather than separate pages per preference. Explain Prefer SDH fallback versus strict Only SDH automatic/search/download selection, matching device caption appearance, replacement confirmation and leaving matching through custom edits.

trackers.summary: Use the trackers task for profile sign-ins, media eligibility, list/history behavior, configured WeTrakr availability, Retry/Reconnect and failed revocation recovery; retain Apple TV-only Last.fm and separate cross-server history/iCloud sync.
